reachable: Yes, on both axes, verified by execution. OPTIM: the averaging rewrites every parameter of the net that the instrument then scores. In a real end-to-end run of `evolve.harness._train` on this genome I instrumented `_SnapshotAverage.finalize` and confirmed: 4 snapshots collected, `wrote=True`, and max|final_params - snapshot_mean| = 0.0 while max|final_params - pre-merge final iterate| = 3.0e-3, a 9.4% max relative displacement. The averaged net is finite and its eval forward is deterministic (pred rms 1.39). The merge fires on the last `opt.step()` (t reaches `total` because `_train` loops `for step in range(1, steps+1)` and passes the same `steps` to `make_opt`), and nothing after it touches parameters — `sched.step()` only sets LR. So the mechanism unconditionally influences the prediction at the scored read position. ARCH: occlusion has zero parameters, so "gets gradient" does not apply; it changes which gradients flow throughout training and is gated on `self.training`. `occ_step` incremented exactly once per optimiser step (measured: occ_step == 120 after 120 steps) — the head's aux loss calls `net.transition_from_emb`, not `forward`, so it does not double-count. At eval the mechanism is off and the forward is bit-for-bit the unoccluded parent forward (`torch.equal` True against a plain R20 loaded with the same state dict); `stream.leakage_ok` (baseline_interleave line 41), `cups_probe` line 135 and `M.flatten_predictions` line 271 each call `net.eval()`, and nothing calls `net.train()` after training. Crucially I also verified the hypothesis's central mechanical claim about the read position: an occluded mid-sequence pair produces a prediction at the read command that is identical to the scoring layout where the obs slot is simply absent (max diff 4.8e-7, float reassociation from the differing sequence length). Given the ground truth that training collate clears key_pad for a cmd and its obs together — so "command present, observation absent" is identically false in training — this occlusion is exactly the mechanism that makes the scored condition in-distribution, as claimed.
solves_outside_model: No. Neither new file reads a command string, path, observation text or any metadata — grep for cmds/split(/image/str/json/startswith over both files returns only hits inside DESCRIPTION prose. The optim sees only parameter tensors, their shapes and its own step counter; the occlusion mask is `torch.rand(B, n_pair) < p`, content-independent, applied only to odd (observation) positions, never to commands. `tok_emb.masked_fill` and `key_pad | drop_full` both allocate new tensors, so the batch dict the harness holds (and hence `b["tgt"]`, built by collate from z_obs, and the head's read of `batch["tok"]`) is unmodified — "targets are untouched" is literally true. The one command-parsing component in this genome is the batcher (`_chain_length` following `mv src dst`), which is the parent's, unchanged, and it parses only to weight SAMPLE selection — the legitimate kind. Nothing resolved by this candidate's code enters the model's input, at scoring time or ever, and no prior-retraction shape (resolved identity stamped into a token) is present.
summary: The code does what the hypothesis says. This is a crossover that keeps the parent's optimiser wholesale and adds cyclical tail snapshot averaging (SWA/snapshot-ensemble form), plus a verbatim transplant of the partner's ramped observation occlusion onto the parent's dual-key arch. Every checkable construction claim held up under execution, including several stated numbers the author could not have run: hi = 0.5702 ("~0.57 of peak"); floor 0.05; avg_start = S - 0.35S; cyc_len = ceil(span/4); the pre-tail envelope is byte-for-byte the parent's warmup-hold-cosine (I diffed `_schedule_lambda` against `_plan.envelope`); parameter count 3.13M ("about 3M"); exactly one (768,768) matrix (tr_read.weight) gets the spectral cap, so "one extra spectral-cap projection on a single (768,768) matrix" is exact; occlusion drop rate measured at 0.1192 against p=0.12; smoothstep ramp 300->1000 as specified. Each of the 4 snapshot marks lands at the LR minimum at the end of a restart, which is the SWA prescription the hypothesis cites, and the t=S snapshot is taken before the merge, so the final iterate is included in the mean. The "why occlusion is coherent on this host" trace (valid_obs False -> live_pair 0 -> pres_pair 0 -> beta 0, lam 1, zero saliency mass, zero obs_for_prev) is correct line by line and I confirmed its consequence numerically: an occluded pair is indistinguishable from the scoring layout's "read command with no observation" at the read position. Three minor divergences, none affecting the mechanism: the snapshot count is 4, not the 5 the file implies twice; "a third of the cosine decay" is really 47%; and the inherited claim that Muon runs on "the addressing projections" is loose because the shape-based selector also sweeps in sys_val.weight. The hypothesis is unusually honest elsewhere — it labels its speed claim as construction-time, lists five concrete failure modes including the one that matters (the four snapshots may not be linearly connected), and its account of the batcher's per-step image resampling checks out against r20_depthtilted_sysblock_curriculum (chosen image redrawn every call, n_hard = 48 of 64 from 30% of the budget onward). WHAT I COULD NOT CHECK: anything about outcome. No data root or GPU here, so I could not test whether the averaged iterate scores better or worse, whether the four tail iterates are in one basin at the full 4000-step budget, whether p=0.12 occlusion blinds more windows than it teaches, or whether the averaged bank survives the norm_ok/dispersion_ok guards. The 1/sqrt(n) cancellation argument is a rationale, not a code claim, and is untested. My end-to-end run used 120 steps on synthetic sequences, so it validates plumbing and reachability, not training dynamics. CLEANUP: nothing in the repo was modified and nothing was installed; all work was in the session scratchpad (the one monkeypatch of `_SnapshotAverage.finalize` lived inside a throwaway subprocess).

divergences.claim: "at t = avg_start + c*cyc_len for c = 1..avg_cycles, AND at t = S, it adds the current value of every parameter into a float32 accumulator" / speed section: "avg_cycles+1 copies of the parameter vector ... five times over the whole run".
divergences.what_the_code_does: `_plan` builds marks = {total} ∪ {min(total, avg_start + c*cyc_len) : c=1..n_cyc}. Because avg_start + n_cyc*cyc_len >= total by construction, the c=n_cyc mark clips to exactly `total`, so the set collapses to n_cyc = 4 distinct marks. The average is over 4 iterates, not 5.
divergences.evidence: Executed `_plan(S, 0.04, 0.30, 0.05, 0.35, 4)`: S=4000 -> marks [2950, 3300, 3650, 4000] (4); S=3000 -> [2213,2476,2739,3000]; S=6000 -> [4425,4950,5475,6000]; S=2000 -> [1475,1650,1825,2000]. End-to-end run of evolve.harness._train on this genome (STEPS=120) reported `snapshots: 4`. The mechanism is unaffected (all 4 marks land at the LR floor at the end of a restart, and the t=S snapshot is taken before finalize); only the count and the stated copy cost are off by one.

divergences.claim: "hi is ~0.57 of the peak LR, reached only after warmup, hold and a third of the cosine decay".
divergences.what_the_code_does: hi = 0.5702 (correct), but avg_start sits 47% of the way through the cosine decay, not a third: p = (avg_start - decay_start)/(S - decay_start) = (2600-1360)/2640 = 0.470 at S=4000.
divergences.evidence: Computed from `_plan` with the genome's fractions: warm=160, decay_start=1360, avg_start=2600, envelope(avg_start)=0.5702. Prose slip only; the stated formulas and the 0.57 figure match the code exactly.

divergences.claim: "Muon on the (key_d x d) addressing projections" (module DESCRIPTION and hypothesis line 44).
divergences.what_the_code_does: The selector routes every 2-D parameter with shape[0]==key_d==64 and shape[1] not in {64,768} that has a same-shape sibling. On this arch that is 7 tensors, and one of them — sys_val.weight (64,176), the system-summary VALUE projection — is not an addressing projection.
divergences.evidence: Enumerated the group on a real net: file_read, file_write, path_read, path_write, sys_val, tr_path, tr_path_w — all (64,176). The selector code is character-identical to the parent's r18_spectral_capped_transition_readout, so this is an inherited mis-description, not something this candidate introduced; the hypothesis's actual claim ("keeps all three of those components" unchanged) is true.
